summary: MIPDaL is a one-year Erasmus Mundus master's in intellectual property and data law, coordinated by TU Dresden with TalTech in Estonia, Carlos III University of Madrid, the University of Strasbourg's CEIPI, Queen Mary University of London and the University of Exeter. Twelve scholarships a year pay €1,400 a month and all fees. Scholarship applications are due by 15 January 2027.
meta_title: MIPDaL 2027: Erasmus Mundus IP and data law scholarship
meta_description: MIPDaL gives 12 scholarships a year of €1,400 a month plus all fees for a one-year IP and data law master's in Europe and the UK. Apply by 15 January 2027.
covers: No consortium fees: self-funded non-European students pay €11,990 a year.
No UK top-up fee for the second semester at Queen Mary (£20,050) or Exeter (£12,000).
€1,400 a month for accommodation, travel and living costs.
eligibility: Applicants of any nationality. Neither of your two study countries can be your country of residence when you enrol.
A degree of at least 240 ECTS (four years) in law or a law-related field, equivalent to a UK upper second (2:1).
English at C1 (B2+ in exceptional cases). Only native speakers and graduates of the UK's majority English-speaking countries are exempt, which leaves out Ghana and Nigeria.
The programme says that in practice only applicants with a First Class degree and C1 English have a realistic chance of a scholarship.
how_to_apply: Apply on the MIPDaL application portal. Applications for 2027–2028 opened on 1 October 2026.

Upload a CV (Europass recommended), ID, degree certificates, a certified transcript with English translation, proof of English, a statement of purpose and an academic reference letter (a professional one if you left university at least three years ago).
Scholarship applicants and early birds must submit everything by 15 January 2027. Other applicants have until 15 March 2027, with late applications from 15 April to 15 June 2027.
watch_out: Only 12 scholarships a year, so apply for other funding too.
Self-funded students who accept pay a non-refundable first instalment of €700, with the rest due on 31 July.
The application portal lists a later closing date for its scholarship campaign, but the programme's own pages say 15 January 2027. Use 15 January.

faq.q: When is the MIPDaL scholarship deadline?
faq.a: 15 January 2027 for scholarship applicants and early birds.

faq.q: What degree do I need for MIPDaL?
faq.a: At least 240 ECTS (four years) in law or a law-related field, equivalent to a UK 2:1.

faq.q: How many MIPDaL scholarships are there?
faq.a: Up to 12 a year, each paying €1,400 a month plus all fees.
